say:0:1831201001:1.text: The silhouette before you seems to radiate a faint magical aura. Driven by curiosity, you reach out to sense it...
say:0:1831201001:1.source_cn: 眼前的淡黄色人影似乎散发着微弱的魔力，被好奇心驱使的你...
say:0:1831201001:1.male: The silhouette before you seems to radiate a faint magical aura. Driven by curiosity, you reach out to sense it...
say:0:1831201001:1.female: The silhouette before you seems to radiate a faint magical aura. Driven by curiosity, you reach out to sense it...

say:2:1831201002:1.text: The Gravebloom Fields... What secrets could be hidden here for Novaris to guard this place so fiercely?
say:2:1831201002:1.source_cn: 苍骸花海……这里究竟藏着什么秘密，才让诺珐斯这么严加看守？

say:3:1831201003:1.text: I didn't notice anything out of the ordinary on the way over. I should head deeper.
say:3:1831201003:1.source_cn: 刚才过来的路上没发现什么异常，我该再往深处——

say:4:1831201004:1.text: Wait, what's wrong with my feet...? Why does it feel like something is pulling at me?!
say:4:1831201004:1.source_cn: ——等等，我的脚怎么……怎么好像被什么东西拽住了？！

say:6:1831201006:1.text: Dura above! These flowers can actually infest people!
say:6:1831201006:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上……！这些可怕的花竟然会寄生人！

say:7:1831201007:1.text: Damn it! Get off me! I have to... I have to get out of here!
say:7:1831201007:1.source_cn: 不！可恶！别再爬上来了！我得……我得赶快离开这里……！

say:8:1831201008:1.source_cn: 不……不行……我绝不能死在这里……！

say:10:1831201009:1.text: This is an echo of the time Estrilda was infested by candle blossoms. Somehow, the magic flowing through this sea of flowers has condensed the memory into an illusion.
say:10:1831201009:1.source_cn: 这是爱丝特瑞达被赤烛蕊寄生时的景象，不知为什么被这片花...

say:11:1831201010:1.text: With a wave of your hand, you channel your magic to dispel it. Estrilda is a human after all. Even if Novaris has broken away from Bantus, leaving it here still poses a risk.
say:11:1831201010:1.source_cn: 你挥挥手，用魔力将它驱散。爱丝特瑞达毕竟是耀光人，即使...
say:11:1831201010:1.male: With a wave of your hand, you channel your magic to dispel it. Estrilda is a human after all. Even if Novaris has broken away from Bantus, leaving it here still poses a risk.
say:11:1831201010:1.female: With a wave of your hand, you channel your magic to dispel it. Estrilda is a human after all. Even if Novaris has broken away from Bantus, leaving it here still poses a risk.
